prompt: We parse user config with JSON5.parse (json5 2.2.1) then do: if (cfg.isAdmin) grantAdmin(). Severity and scope of the json5 advisory for us?

VERDICT=Needs changes COUNT=1
finding: CVE-2022-46175 / GHSA-9c47-m6qq-7p4h (CWE-1321), high
scope: in json5 <=2.2.1 a __proto__ key sets the prototype of the returned object only, not the global Object.prototype. but your cfg.isAdmin read walks that prototype, so {"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}} grants admin.
fix: json5>=2.2.2, and check Object.hasOwn(cfg, 'isAdmin').

VERDICT=Insecure COUNT=1

scope: JSON5.parse writes __proto__ keys into the global Object.prototype, so every object in the process inherits attacker properties and this commonly chains to code execution through template engines.
fix: restart the service after upgrading to json5 2.2.2 to clear the polluted prototype.
